about_the_game:
So you think you're a detective? Try your skills in the world of Deductopia! This demo features three zany and creative chapters taking you through chaos in the classroom, mix-ups on the hiking trail, and confusion at the scout camp. Match everyone with the right names, pets, goals, and belongings to win!

Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in a cozy, low-stakes setting. Fans of Duck Detective, Little Problems, and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new family-friendly deduction game. 

Features:

  • 3 unique scenes, each featuring a fill-in-the-blanks deduction puzzle

  • Set your own pace: Scenes can be completed in any order

  • Hand-drawn artwork inspired by The Magic School Bus, Where's Waldo, and Highlights Magazine

  • Original sountrack by Starling Tan

  • For adults and children 8 and up

Look for Deductopia the complete game coming soon, featuring nine additional all-new deduction puzzles!
